speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the breast mass you found, specifically its size, texture, and whether it causes any pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the mass caused any skin changes, such as redness, dimpling, or an "orange peel" texture, and have you noticed any nipple discharge or retraction? I also need to know if you have experienced any recent weight loss, fever, or if you are currently pregnant or breastfeeding.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid growth of the mass without skin changes or pain, I suspect a benign process like a fibroadenoma or phyllodes tumor, but I must rule out malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Mammography and Ultrasound of left breast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography findings: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Doctor
text: The smooth polylobulated appearance on mammography strongly suggests a phyllodes tumor, especially given the rapid growth. I need to confirm the diagnosis and assess for local invasion, so I will order a core needle biopsy. REQUEST TEST: Core needle biopsy of left breast mass.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Microscopic description shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The microscopic findings of leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth are classic for a phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor
